services.title: Our services
services.venues.label: EXCLUSIVE VENUES
services.venues.desc: Exclusive access to up to 4 unique estates (Ca n'Alzina, Mas Vivens, Can Macià and Castell de Tous) for your big day.
services.coord.label: COORDINATION & GUIDANCE
services.coord.desc: Full support from day one through to the wedding. A team of professionals with years of experience in weddings, at your service.
services.ceremony.label: UNIQUE CEREMONIES
services.ceremony.desc: Setup, floral decoration and coordination of one of the most special moments of your big day.
services.decor.label: DECORATION
services.decor.desc: Tableware and floral centrepieces chosen from a wide variety of on-trend options, updated year after year.
services.catering.label: GASTRONOMY
services.catering.desc: Design your own menu with an extensive range of canapé options, buffets, live cooking stations and banquet dishes.
services.festa.label: CELEBRATION
services.festa.desc: DJ and bartender service to bring an unforgettable celebration to a perfect close.
